image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel featuring a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (silver outer spokes and bright yellow inner accents). The rim is mounted with a black rubber tire showing visible tread and sidewall details. The central hub contains lug nuts and a center cap with a logo. Behind the spokes, a brake disc and caliper assembly are partially visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The bright yellow color on the inner parts of the spokes appears slightly 'painted on' or digitally overlaid rather than having the physical depth of powder coating or anodizing. It lacks subtle specular highlights compared to the silver areas.

The background elements (possibly wood or ground) are indistinct and blurry, which is common in AI generation but could also be depth-of-field. Marked as minor artifact due to lack of structural definition.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of alloy wheel and ensure it matches the 'car wheel' class label with high confidence.
To check for any fusion or bleeding between the rubber tire and the metal rim, a common AI failure point.
To verify that the spaces between spokes reveal a logically consistent brake disc and caliper structure behind them.
To assess the realism of the lighting reflections on the metallic surfaces and the yellow paint.

focus_areas: Integrity of the lug nut geometry (are they uniform and correctly threaded?)
Physical plausibility of the brake components visible through the spokes
Edge sharpness between the tire sidewall and the rim lip
Consistency of reflections on the metallic vs. painted yellow surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'yellow' sections of the wheel. In AI images, secondary colors on complex mechanical parts often suffer from 'texture flattening' or lack proper material definition (e.g., looking like matte plastic instead of coated metal). Also, verify if the brake disc behind the spokes maintains a consistent circular geometry or if it warps/melts into the background.
